tools.name: market_data_fetcher
tools.description: Streams real-time and historical price, volume, and volatility data from Bloomberg.

tools.name: portfolio_reader
tools.description: Reads current portfolio positions, weights, and client mandate constraints.

tools.name: risk_model_engine
tools.description: Computes VaR, CVaR, factor exposures, and stress-test outcomes using internal quant models.

tools.name: sec_filing_reader
tools.description: Downloads and parses 10-K, 10-Q, and 8-K filings from SEC EDGAR.

tools.name: trade_executor
tools.description: Submits limit and market orders to the brokerage execution layer. Requires compliance pre-check.

tools.name: compliance_screener
tools.description: Cross-checks a security against the regulatory watchlist and AML/sanctions databases.

tools.name: report_writer
tools.description: Generates daily risk summary and trade attribution reports in PDF and JSON.
